newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 252 OF OCTOBER 4, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 252 OF OCTOBER 4, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 1 October 1996 suspending the buying-in of butter in certain Member States (Only the Danish, German, Greek, French, Dutch, Portuguese, Finnish and Swedish texts are authentic) (96/574/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 29 May 1996 concerning State aid to the Greek steel company Halyvourgia Thessalias SA (Only the Greek text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (96/573/ECSC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1919/96 of 3 October 1996 amending representative prices and additional duties for the import of certain products in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1918/96 of 3 October 1996 altering the export refunds on milk and milk products

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1917/96 of 3 October 1996 temporarily suspending the issuing of export licences for certain milk products and determining what proportion of the amounts covered by pending applications for export licences may be allocated
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1916/96 of 3 October 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1915/96 of 3 October 1996 amending Regulation (EC) No 554/95 laying down detailed rules for the description and presentation of sparkling and aerated sparkling wine
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1914/96 of 3 October 1996 amending for the 16th time Regulation (EEC) No 3800/81 determining the classification of vine varieties END OF DOCUMENT.
